name: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island

address.street: Red Sea Project? East Shura Island The

insider_take: A once-in-a-lifetime escape where desert grandeur meets pristine Red Sea waters — Saudi Arabia's most ambitious luxury resort destination has arrived.
whats_special: Shura Island is part of the groundbreaking AMAALA mega-project , Saudi Arabia's ultra-luxury tourism destination dubbed the "Riviera of the Middle East" The resort sits within a pristine coral reef ecosystem , with the Red Sea hosting over 1,200 species of fish and some of the world's most untouched marine biodiversity Guests enjoy exclusive island seclusion — Shura Island is purpose-built, meaning every detail of the surrounding environment has been crafted around the resort experience The Red Sea coastline here boasts year-round sunshine with over 300 sunny days annually and warm, crystal-clear waters perfect for world-class diving and snorkeling
pro_tip: Book a guided diving or snorkeling excursion directly through the resort — the nearby Red Sea reefs are among the most biodiverse and least-crowded in the world, offering encounters with dolphins, manta rays, and vibrant coral gardens that few travelers have ever witnessed.
dont_miss: Sunset on the Red Sea — the views from Shura Island at dusk, with the water turning shades of gold and amber, are absolutely spectacular World-class water sports — the island's protected waters make it an ideal playground for kayaking, paddleboarding, and sailing AMAALA's Wellness Offerings — the broader destination is designed around a "triple bay" wellness philosophy, making spa and holistic experiences here truly extraordinary
pros: Exclusive private island setting on the pristine Red Sea with stunning overwater and beachfront villas
World-class Four Seasons service and ultra-luxury amenities including multiple pools, a spa, and fine dining restaurants
Direct access to vibrant coral reefs and exceptional water sports, snorkeling, and diving experiences
Spacious private residences available for extended stays, blending resort luxury with home-like comfort
Pioneer destination within Saudi Arabia's ambitious NEOM Red Sea Project, offering a truly one-of-a-kind travel experience
cons: Remote island location requires advance planning for travel logistics and access
Ultra-luxury pricing places this resort at the highest end of the market
As a newly developed destination, surrounding infrastructure and off-resort activities are still emerging
